title: VOD Playback Stabilization, Seamless Transitions, Start-at-Beginning & Podcasts Navigation
releaseNotes:
• VOD Playback Stabilization: Fixed stream errors and socket drops across the app with dedicated OkHttp dispatcher and extended 25s buffering headroom
• Seamless Media Transitions: Switch between any media (Live TV, Movies, Series, Podcasts, Music) with clean state reset and zero need to restart app
• VOD Start-at-Beginning: Movies and Series strictly start from 0:00 unless 'Resume' is explicitly chosen in the dialog
• Podcasts Remote Back Navigation: Pressing Back on remote when viewing a channel's episode list returns directly to previous search or category view
• Dashboard Re-Publishing: Re-publish former or archived releases directly from the update dashboard with one click
